# autoglue_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages an Autoglue load balancer (logical endpoint, identified by kind and IPs).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Load balancer kind. One of `glueops` or `public`.
- `name` (String) Load balancer name.
- `private_ip_address` (String) Private IPv4 address advertised by this load balancer.
- `public_ip_address` (String) Public IPv4 address advertised by this load balancer.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) LoadBalancer ID (UUID).
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
